selection: First 12 items in the packet's pre-existing deterministic shuffled order; selected and developer-labelled before running the unchanged article-role prompt on this packet.
label_scope: Developer assessment from saved title and abstract, not independent expert gold or full-text verification.

decision_policy.direct: Primary empirical or computational research on all essential qualifiers in the target topic; broad area targets permit primary work on a constituent mechanism.
decision_policy.related: Topically adjacent, review, enabling method, or partial qualifiers; not direct evidence for the full target.
decision_policy.not_direct: Target mechanism or requested application is absent or different.
decision_policy.uncertain: Title/abstract do not allow the requested directness and publication role to be judged.
